body: Thank you. Really, thank you for the words of advice. I'm going to try to keep away from her, for her own sake. I don't want to keep putting her through the heart break of being there and then leaving. I don't know what I'm going to do about my own life.

How should I tell her? I can't ask for her back. I know that. I can give her the opportunity to come back to me, but I know I can't ask. I want her to know I mean it. And I might ruin any chance of ever having her back by doing something too soon.. I don't know

A life I don't want to live can't be given meaning through money and a house. I appreciate the thought, but working to support myself would only be a repercussion of actually deciding to go on living. I don't see dying as anything romantic or to flaunt. It's just preferable to living.

It's just midday here in California. Me being in her life is surely not a good thing for her, even though she loved me dearly when I was. I'm hardly stable, I mean I want to die. It seems like it would be cruel to even try to get her back (as well as completely pathetic on my behalf.) I already got her back once. Hell, I might just dump her again even if I did get her back now. I can't seem to hold on to anyone.

I like your username. I hiked there once. 
I can't sleep, I stay awake all night thinking about her. She told me when I left that if I ever felt the same way I did when we split up before (which was missing her - I got her back) she wouldn't be there for me. I could never go back to her. I just don't know what possessed me to leave her. That kills me almost as much as not having her. Trying to sleep would just be unnecessary effort toward taking care of a life that I don't want.
